package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go/v2"

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language: `caddy`,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`:8080 {
	respond "Hello"
}`, config)
	if err != nil {
